item.title: Comment on How To Wear Blanket Scarves For Winter by Dijkstra De Jaager
item.description: Yes, I have a blanket scarf and love wearing it very much. It is very practicle and except for those throw blankets that are very pricey, that practice seems to be catching on and has now made the covers and articles of higher-end glossy clothing magazines.
